name: casual
style: Modern mobile casual: chunky, bright, glossy, cartoon. Bold shapes, saturated colours, short and punchy. Not realistic, not gritty.
moduleNeeds: three >= 0.182 provided by the page through an import map

effects.name: hit.impact
effects.whenToUse: Something gets hit: a punch, a sword slash landing, a ball striking a block, a bullet hitting a wall.

effects.name: hit.slash
effects.whenToUse: A sword, claw or blade slash hits. Aim it along the swing: in 2D set dir (degrees, default down-right); in 3D pass direction: [x, y, z].

effects.name: hit.punch
effects.whenToUse: A punch, kick, headbutt or blunt hit lands. Bigger and rounder than hit.impact; good for boxing, brawlers, cartoon fights.

effects.name: hit.bullet
effects.whenToUse: A bullet, arrow, laser bolt or thrown pebble hits a surface or an enemy. Small and fast; can fire many times a second.

effects.name: hit.crit
effects.whenToUse: A critical hit, a super move landing, a weak-point strike, a headshot. Louder than hit.impact.

effects.name: hit.block
effects.whenToUse: A crate, brick, wall, rock or block is hit or breaks. Tint it the colour of the material (wood, stone, ice).

effects.name: hit.blood
effects.whenToUse: A creature takes a bloody hit in an action game. Aim it: in 2D set dir (degrees, default up); in 3D pass direction: [x, y, z], the way the blood flies (away from the weapon). Tint green for slime or zombies, black for oil or ink, purple for aliens.

effects.name: hit.shieldbreak
effects.whenToUse: A shield, barrier, bubble or armour breaks. Play where the shield was, then stop its state.shield loop.

effects.name: hit.parry
effects.whenToUse: A parry, a perfect block, a deflected bullet, swords clashing, a counter. Sharp and bright. Aim the spark spray: dir (degrees) in 2D, direction: [x, y, z] in 3D (default up).

effects.name: hit.shieldzap
effects.whenToUse: A shield, force field or energy barrier takes a hit: an energy bolt striking a shield, a shocking blow blocked, an electric barrier zapped.

effects.name: explosion.small
effects.whenToUse: A small thing blows up: a barrel, an enemy, a car crash, a bomb, a rocket landing. About 150px wide.

effects.name: explosion.big
effects.whenToUse: A boss dies, a building or tank blows up, a big bomb goes off, a level-ending blast. Twice the size of explosion.small.

effects.name: explosion.puff
effects.whenToUse: Something vanishes, pops or gets squashed without fire: an enemy poofing away, a balloon, a magic disappearance, a cartoon collision.

effects.name: explosion.fireball
effects.whenToUse: A fire spell lands, a fuel can ignites, a dragon breath hits, a torch bursts. Fire without the smoke of an explosion.

effects.name: explosion.firework
effects.whenToUse: Celebrations and fun blasts: fireworks on a win screen, a party popper, a magic burst. Tint it or leave it multicolour.

effects.name: explosion.nuke
effects.whenToUse: A bomb power-up clears the board, a super attack wipes every enemy, the final boss dies. Covers the whole screen; play once.

effects.name: pickup.sparkle
effects.whenToUse: The player collects a coin, gem, star, key, heart or any small item. Also for a star earned on a result screen.

effects.name: pickup.coin
effects.whenToUse: A coin or money is collected. More "coin" than pickup.sparkle: a little coin pops up and fades. Also for a cash reward.

effects.name: pickup.gem
effects.whenToUse: A gem, diamond, crystal or premium currency is collected. Tint it to the gem colour (purple, green, red).

effects.name: pickup.heart
effects.whenToUse: A heart, life or health item is collected, a pet is petted, a character is happy or in love.

effects.name: pickup.powerup
effects.whenToUse: A power-up, booster, mushroom, shield or weapon upgrade is collected. Bigger and louder than a coin.

effects.name: pickup.xp
effects.whenToUse: Experience, mana, energy or souls are gained. Soft orbs float up from the point. Tint to the resource colour.

effects.name: pickup.key
effects.whenToUse: A key, a pass, a ticket or an access card is collected; a door unlocks.

effects.name: pickup.food
effects.whenToUse: A character eats food, a pet is fed, a potion of stamina is drunk, a snack is collected. Tint to the food colour.

effects.name: reward.confetti
effects.whenToUse: A win: level complete, new record, chest opened, prize claimed. Fire it from the bottom or the middle of the screen; in 3D from the ground or a cannon, with direction: [x, y, z] to aim it (default straight up).

effects.name: reward.levelup
effects.whenToUse: The player levels up, upgrades an item, unlocks something, or completes a big milestone. Play on the character or the item.

effects.name: reward.starburst
effects.whenToUse: A star is earned, a perfect score, a combo milestone, a badge unlocked. Punchier than pickup.sparkle.

effects.name: reward.combo
effects.whenToUse: A combo counter goes up, a chain reaction step, a rapid hit streak. Short enough to fire several times a second. Tint by combo level.

effects.name: reward.chest
effects.whenToUse: A chest, crate, gift box, egg or loot bag opens. Play on the box; the rays shine upward.

effects.name: reward.coinshower
effects.whenToUse: A big money reward: jackpot, chest of coins, level payout, daily bonus. Covers the whole screen from the top.

effects.name: reward.clear
effects.whenToUse: Level complete, stage clear, game won. A whole-screen celebration. Play once when the result screen appears.

effects.name: move.jump
effects.whenToUse: A character jumps, lands, or starts running. Play at the feet. Also a soft landing for a dropped object.

effects.name: move.footstep
effects.whenToUse: Each footstep of a walking character, a hoof, a paw; tiny and quick. For continuous running use move.dust instead.

effects.name: move.land
effects.whenToUse: A big landing, a ground pound, a heavy object dropped, a stomp. Wider and flatter than move.jump.

effects.name: move.dash
effects.whenToUse: A dodge, a dash, a blink or a sudden burst of speed. The streaks fly BACKWARD, opposite to the dash: in 2D set dir (degrees, default left = dashing right); in 3D pass direction: [x, y, z] (the opposite of the movement).

effects.name: move.splash
effects.whenToUse: Something falls into or jumps out of water, a puddle is stepped in, a boat hits a wave. Play at the water surface.

effects.name: move.teleport
effects.whenToUse: A character teleports, blinks, warps in or out, or is summoned. Play at both the start and the end point.

effects.name: move.spawn
effects.whenToUse: An enemy, item or character appears or respawns, a block is placed, a building finishes. Gentle and quick.

effects.name: move.trail
effects.whenToUse: A dash, a speeding car, a thrown ball, a flying character or a dragged item. Start it with follow, stop it when the move ends.

effects.name: move.dust
effects.whenToUse: A character or vehicle is running or driving on the ground. Follow the feet or wheels; stop when they stop.

effects.name: move.speed
effects.whenToUse: Something is moving very fast: a sprint, a boost, a falling player, a racing car. Lines stream backward: in 2D set dir (degrees, default left); in 3D pass direction: [x, y, z] (opposite to the movement) and keep it current with handle.aim(v) while the character turns.

effects.name: move.swim
effects.whenToUse: A character or fish is swimming or diving. Follow the body; stop when it leaves the water.

effects.name: move.fly
effects.whenToUse: A bird, bee, dragon or winged character is flying or hovering. Follow the body; stop on landing.

effects.name: move.skid
effects.whenToUse: A car drifts or brakes hard, a character slides to a stop, a cart skids. Follow the wheels; stop when grip returns.

effects.name: magic.heal
effects.whenToUse: Health restored, a potion drunk, a shrine touched, a buff applied. Play on the character.

effects.name: magic.ice
effects.whenToUse: An ice spell hits, something freezes or shatters, a frost trap triggers, an ice block breaks.

effects.name: magic.lightning
effects.whenToUse: A lightning spell, a thunder strike, an electric trap or a shock hit. The bolt comes down from above the point.

effects.name: magic.shield
effects.whenToUse: A shield, barrier or block activates, an attack is deflected, armour absorbs a hit. For a lasting bubble use state.shield.

effects.name: magic.poison
effects.whenToUse: A poison attack, an acid splash, a toxic barrel breaks, a swamp bubble pops. For an ongoing poisoned status use state.poison.

effects.name: magic.dark
effects.whenToUse: A curse, a shadow attack, a necromancer spell, a ghost appearing, something evil activating.

effects.name: magic.holy
effects.whenToUse: A blessing, a revive, an angel or shrine, a holy attack, a character ascending. Rays shine upward from the point.

effects.name: magic.portal
effects.whenToUse: A portal, warp gate, level exit, summoning circle or teleporter that stays open. Stop it when it closes.

effects.name: magic.cast
effects.whenToUse: A character charges or casts a spell, an item is being crafted or upgraded, a machine powers up. Stop it when the spell fires.

effects.name: magic.fire
effects.whenToUse: A fireball, a flaming arrow, a meteor or any burning projectile while it flies. Play with follow on the projectile; stop it on impact and play explosion.fireball.

effects.name: magic.summon
effects.whenToUse: A creature, ally or boss is summoned; a ritual completes; a big spell is cast from a circle. Play at the feet.

effects.name: magic.curse
effects.whenToUse: A curse, hex, debuff or drain lands on a character; a cursed item is picked up. Play on the body.

effects.name: state.stun
effects.whenToUse: A character or enemy is stunned, dizzy or knocked out. Play above the head with follow, stop when they recover.

effects.name: state.poison
effects.whenToUse: A character or enemy is poisoned or sick. Play on the body with follow; stop when it wears off.

effects.name: state.burning
effects.whenToUse: A character, enemy, torch, campfire or object is burning. Play on it with follow; stop when the fire goes out.

effects.name: state.frozen
effects.whenToUse: A character or enemy is frozen, slowed or chilled. Play on the body with follow; stop when it thaws.

effects.name: state.shield
effects.whenToUse: A character has an active shield, barrier, invincibility or bubble. Follow the character; stop when it breaks. Combine with magic.shield for the pop-on and hit.impact for hits.

effects.name: state.rage
effects.whenToUse: A character is angry, enraged, berserk or powered up with a damage boost. Follow the head; stop when it ends.

effects.name: state.regen
effects.whenToUse: Health regenerates over time, a healing zone is active, a medic aura. Follow the character; stop when healing ends. For a one-off heal use magic.heal.

effects.name: state.sparkle
effects.whenToUse: Something wants attention: a collectible on the map, a ready reward, a new item, a rare enemy, a clickable object. Follow it; stop when it is taken.

effects.name: state.smoke
effects.whenToUse: A damaged vehicle, machine or building smokes; a chimney; a snuffed candle; something overheating. Follow it; stop when repaired.

effects.name: state.love
effects.whenToUse: A pet is happy, a character is in love or charmed, a customer is satisfied, a plant is thriving. Follow the head; stop when the mood ends.

effects.name: state.sleep
effects.whenToUse: A character or pet is asleep, resting, idle for a long time, or knocked out cold. Follow the head; stop on waking.

effects.name: state.invisible
effects.whenToUse: A character is invisible, cloaked, a ghost, or phasing. Follow the body (draw the character at low opacity yourself); stop when visible again.

effects.name: state.charged
effects.whenToUse: A character is electrified, stunned by a shock, or carrying a charged power. Also a live wire or a generator. Follow it; stop when it discharges.

effects.name: state.dome
effects.whenToUse: A force field, energy dome or barrier shield goes up around a character, a base or an object and stays until it is switched off. Play it at the feet / on the ground; call stop() and the dome breaks apart on its own (state.domebreak).

effects.name: state.domebreak
effects.whenToUse: An energy dome or force field is switched off or destroyed. Played automatically when state.dome is stopped; play it yourself only for a dome the game drew itself.

effects.name: env.snow
effects.whenToUse: A winter level, a Christmas event, a cold mountain scene. Start it once when the level begins; it covers the whole screen.

effects.name: env.rain
effects.whenToUse: A rainy level, a storm, a sad scene. Start it once when the level begins; it covers the whole screen.

effects.name: env.leaves
effects.whenToUse: An autumn or forest level, a windy park, a garden. Tint pink for cherry blossom petals. Covers the whole screen from the top.

effects.name: env.embers
effects.whenToUse: A lava level, a burning city, a campfire scene, a volcano, a forge. Rises from the bottom of the screen.

effects.name: env.bubbles
effects.whenToUse: An underwater level, an aquarium, a soap or bath scene, a potion lab. Rises from the bottom of the screen.

effects.name: env.fog
effects.whenToUse: A spooky graveyard, a swamp, a morning meadow, a haunted house. Sits along the bottom of the screen and drifts sideways.

effects.name: env.stars
effects.whenToUse: A night sky, a space level, a dream sequence, a magic realm. Covers the whole screen; put it behind the game if you can (it is a background feel).

effects.name: env.fireflies
effects.whenToUse: A night forest, a fairy glade, a calm evening, a magical garden. Soft lights drifting everywhere.

effects.name: env.dust
effects.whenToUse: A sunlit room, an attic, a desert, a cave, an old library. Tiny motes drifting everywhere; very subtle.

effects.name: env.sandstorm
effects.whenToUse: A desert level, a dust storm, a windy wasteland. In 2D it blows left to right (dir 180 reverses). In 3D it blows along the ground: direction: [x, y, z], or dir as a compass heading (0 = +X, 90 = -Z).

effects.name: env.clouds
effects.whenToUse: A sky background, a flying level, a calm outdoor scene. Very slow; start it once. Play on the back layer if the game has a DOM scene.

effects.name: env.hearts
effects.whenToUse: A love scene, a date, a pet-care screen, a valentine event. Rises from the bottom of the screen.

effects.name: env.confetti
effects.whenToUse: A celebration screen that stays open: a winner podium, a birthday event, a season end. For a one-off burst use reward.confetti or reward.clear.

effects.name: ui.pop
effects.whenToUse: A button, card or toggle is tapped. Small and quick; safe to fire on every tap. Play with { el }.

effects.name: ui.tap
effects.whenToUse: Feedback for a tap on the game itself: placing, selecting, moving to a point. Play with { event }.

effects.name: ui.star
effects.whenToUse: A star on a result screen is earned, a rating star fills, a favourite is marked. Play with { el } on the star.

effects.name: ui.burst
effects.whenToUse: A reward is claimed, a task is checked off, a purchase completes, a gift is opened in the UI. Play with { el }.

effects.name: ui.unlock
effects.whenToUse: A level, skin, character or feature unlocks; a lock icon opens; a new area is revealed. Play with { el }.

effects.name: ui.flash
effects.whenToUse: A screen flash: a huge explosion, a lightning strike, a camera flash, a big hit on the player (tint red), a teleport. Covers the whole screen for a moment.

effects.name: ui.glow
effects.whenToUse: Draw the eye to a button or card: Play, Claim, a ready chest, a new item. Play with { el, follow: true }; stop when tapped.

effects.name: ui.shine
effects.whenToUse: Draw attention to a button, card or banner with a passing shine: Play, Claim, a new offer. Play with { el }; the sweep fits the element width.

effects.name: ui.countup
effects.whenToUse: A score, coin total or XP bar is counting up on a result screen. Play with { el, follow: true } on the counter; stop when the count finishes.
